subject: Order form indemnity — custody of evidence, service credit approval & next steps
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@brightwell.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: indemnity scope and evidence custody (Order Form)

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement at BrightWell is reviewing the proposed MSA + order form and has two open items before we can proceed:

1) Clarify the evidence custody workflow (what logs/artifacts Redwood will preserve if a third‑party IP claim arises).
2) Confirmation of a one‑time service credit or commercial concession tied to defense costs that might be incurred during a third‑party claim.

Can you route this to the right person on your side? We'd like a brief write‑up of the custody scope and a proposed credit cap so our legal/procurement teams can sign off.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
BrightWell Health

Subject: Re: Request: indemnity scope and evidence custody (Order Form)

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear asks.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in Legal (Kimberly) to propose a narrowly‑tailored custody/evidence description and any reasonable notice windows.
- Logan (Procurement) will evaluate a service-credit concession and confirm internal budget/approval path. We're proposing a one‑time service credit up to $25,000 tied specifically to third‑party defense coordination costs; legal needs to confirm that's compatible with the indemnity language.

Kimberly / Logan — can you review the two asks below and share a redline + short explanation of the operational handoff (who collects artifacts, retention period, chain‑of‑custody) by EOD tomorrow? Ellen, we can follow with a 30‑minute sync once we have the proposed language.

Alex
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_order_form_redline.docx (redline stub)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T18:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: indemnity scope and evidence custody (Order Form)

Ellen / Alex,

Thanks — per our internal review I recommend the following high‑level approach (summary + proposed redline attached):

1) Evidence custody: Redwood will preserve (for a 90‑day window following notice) the following artifacts where available: request logs (timestamps, request IDs), model version and digest, KV cache snapshots for the session where the allegedly infringing output was produced, system metadata, and preserved input prompt text provided to Redwood. We will provide a secure SFTP pull or a controlled Drive link to the preserved artifacts; chain‑of‑custody manifest will be footnoted in the order form.

2) Scope narrowing: propose language that limits Redwood's obligation to claims arising from (a) content provided by the customer, or (b) model output that directly reproduces a third‑party's protected work (with examples). This helps reduce open‑ended obligations while being responsive.

3) Service credit: Legal is comfortable with a commercial concession, but it must be an explicit one‑time credit tied to documented defense coordination work (not a cap on indemnity itself). Proposed phrasing: "Customer may request, and Redwood may grant, a one‑time service credit up to $25,000 to offset documented operational costs associated with evidence preservation and coordination during a third‑party IP claim." I note this is a commercial tradeoff and requires Procurement signoff.

See attached: proposed_order_form_redline.docx (tracked changes) and a short evidence custody matrix: evidence_custody_matrix.xlsx

If BrightWell is comfortable with the 90‑day window and the proposed credit phrasing, we can incorporate this into the order form and circulate for a final signoff. Happy to jump on the call tomorrow at 10:00am PT if helpful.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_order_form_redline.docx; evidence_custody_matrix.xlsx
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: indemnity scope and evidence custody (Order Form)

Ellen,

Procurement side here — confirmed internal approval path. We can approve the one‑time service credit up to $25,000 with the following controls:

- Credit only applies when BrightWell documents work that Redwood performed to collect and transfer preserved artifacts (time logs, transfer receipts).
- Credit is applied as an invoice credit on the next billing cycle after the incident is closed.
- We'll require a simple attestation form from BrightWell certifying the defense coordination tasks and estimated costs (template attached).

If that framework works, Alex — please confirm and we'll add the credit line into the order form and route for final signoff (legal and finance signatures). Ellen — once you confirm we will prepare a combined order form with the redline and the short evidence custody summary for execution.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Sr. Contracts & Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_transfer_attestation_template.docx
